title: Derived tensor cohomology action and ordinary counit comparison
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, A and B commutative R-algebras, E=A\otimes_R B [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and Q a cochain complex of A-modules. Suppose D(R) and D(B) with their localization functors Qh and cohomology functors H^i are chosen [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let Q_R be Q restricted to R, and use the additive extension functors [def-weil-module-base-change]. Fix a B-linear complex isomorphism j:B\otimes_R Q_R\cong\operatorname{Res}_{B\to E}(E\otimes_A Q) satisfying j_i(b\otimes q)=(1\otimes b)\otimes q. There exist a total left derived extension L:D(R)\to D(B), its universal counit alpha:L\circ Qh_R\to Qh_B\circ(-\otimes_R B), E-modules T_i, B-linear isomorphisms e_i:\operatorname{Res}_{B\to E}T_i\cong H^i(L(Q_R)), and E-linear maps beta_i:T_i\to H^i(E\otimes_A Q). The isomorphisms intertwine multiplication by a\otimes1 with H^i(L(a\,\mathrm{id}_{Q_R})) for every a\in A. After restricting to B and applying the canonical exact-functor homology isomorphism, beta_i equals e_i followed by H^i(alpha_{Q_R}), the canonical localization-to-complex homology factorization maps, and H^i(j). Module carriers lie in a universe containing R,A,B; the two given derived categories have a common morphism universe. No further coefficient algebra or localized comparison is part of this assertion.

proof.text: Obtain the additive total derived extension, universal counit and base-scalar compatibility from [lem-pc-base-derived-extension-linear].

For each i compose restriction to R, the homotopy quotient, derived localization, the obtained additive derived functor and H^i. Restriction carries multiplication by the image of r in A to multiplication by r on the R-complex, as checked degreewise. Apply [lem-pc-tensor-action-additive-functor] to this additive functor and its base-scalar equation. Choose the E-module and B-linear identification for each degree; its scalar equation is exactly the requested one.

Apply [lem-pc-base-derived-tensor-counit-linear] to the supplied ordinary isomorphism and generator equation, obtained derived functor and counit, and constructed cohomology action. Package the comparison maps and equations with the universal pair and action. No new existence witness is used as definition data.
